title: Rethinking Universal Time Series Foundation Models from Unified Representations to Shared Dynamics (UniTFU)
abstract: arXiv:2611.31921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have attracted increasing attention in cross-domain forecasting. Existing works mainly rely on large-scale pre-training and general modeling paradigms. However, the former heavily relies on the diversity and domain coverage of pre-training data. Meanwhile, the latter learns unified representations across heterogeneous domains without explicitly identifying the temporal regularities shared among them, limiting robust cross-domain generalization. This work explores cross-domain generalization by characterizing commonalities in recurring local dynamics across domains, rather than relying solely on implicitly learned temporal representations. To capture such cross-domain commonalities, we propose Time Series Foundation Units (TFUs) as reusable building blocks discovered from multi-scale temporal segments, each characterizing a recurring local dynamic pattern shared across domains. translated_title: 从统一表示到共享动态：重新思考通用时间序列基础模型（UniTFU）
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在跨领域预测中受到越来越多的关注。现有工作主要依赖大规模预训练和通用建模范式。然而，前者严重依赖于预训练数据的多样性和领域覆盖范围；后者则在异构领域之间学习统一表示，却未能显式识别各领域之间共享的时间规律，从而限制了稳健的跨领域泛化能力。本工作通过刻画跨领域中重复出现的局部动态的共同性来探索跨领域泛化，而非仅仅依赖隐式学习到的时间表示。为了捕捉这种跨领域共同性，我们提出了时间序列基础单元（TFUs），作为从多尺度时间片段中发现的可复用构建模块，每个单元刻画一种跨领域共享的重复性局部动态模式。基于TFUs，我们……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出时间序列基础单元（TFUs）作为从多尺度时间片段中发现的可复用构建模块，通过显式刻画跨领域共享的重复性局部动态模式，而非依赖隐式统一表示，来提升时间序列基础模型的跨领域泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Time Series Foundation Units (TFUs) as reusable building blocks discovered from multi-scale temporal segments, explicitly characterizing recurring local dynamic patterns shared across domains—rather than relying on implicit unified representations—to enhance the cross-domain generalization of time series foundation models.
